entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act to the
ancestors: DIVISION L—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 199D.  None of the funds made available by this Act to the 
Department of Transportation may be used in contravention of section 
306108 of title 54, United States Code.
    This title may be cited as the ``Department of Transportation 
Appropriations Act, 2021''.
